title: Bijective proofs of several conjectures on Jacobi permutations
summary: Jacobi permutations, invented by Viennot in the context of the Jacobi elliptic functions, are counted by the Euler numbers. Recently, Henke, Hoffman, Stephens, Yuan, and Zhuang studied refined enumerations of Jacobi permutations and proposed three conjectures concerning the distribution of several statistics on Jacobi permutations. In this paper, we prove these conjectures by establishing explicit bijections involving increasing even trees, increasing binary trees, alternating permutations, and André permutations.
